title: Treaty of Tripoli
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Tripoli", at revision 1375053986, opens: "The Treaty of Tripoli was signed in 1796. It was the first treaty between the United States and Tripoli to secure commercial shipping rights and protect American ships in the Mediterranean Sea from local Barbary pirates." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1456685, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "treaty between the USA and Tripolitania, ratified in 1797, and remembered for its position on church-state separation". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
